verses.26:63: فَأَوۡحَيۡنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضۡرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلۡبَحۡرَۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرۡقࣲ كَٱلطَّوۡدِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ

meaning: The root طود (Twd) primarily refers to a great mountain, especially one that rises high into the sky. It can also describe an elevated tract of sand.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic hapax root.
